CHILDCARE PROXY. HHPERSRV = childcare + elderly/invalid care + adult day care. Childcare item 670320 exists only for 2023-2024 at the LB06 level. Contamination is asymmetric: in 2024 childcare is 96.5 pct of HHPERSRV for married-with-children, 100 pct for single parents, but only 51.5 pct for single/other CUs. Using HHPERSRV therefore NARROWS the measured family-versus-single childcare gap. Conservative. See decisions_log D-06.
